fd.how.1: An entry is a signed nostr event, sealed before it leaves your browser: for the space, your friends, a circle or yourself. Its photos are encrypted with keys that travel inside it. Whoever cannot read an entry does not see it at all.

fd.diaries.empty: No diaries yet. A diary is a series of entries: a grow from seed to harvest, a build, a season.
fd.how.2: A diary is an entry of its own with a title, a few lines about it and a cover, sealed to its readers like an entry. Each entry in it names the diary and its step inside its own seal, so relays see neither which entries belong together nor what they say; whoever reads the diary puts them in order. What you pin goes to the top of your profile; the diaries you pin in the Diaries tab are for you alone.
